basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Resolves an exact, minimal and acyclic set of model releases for one Dimension, not an open version range.
Separates adoption authority, supplied by the caller, from what a package claims about itself.
Bootstraps only fresh Dimensions and never updates a populated one.

may: Verify an exact composition plan offline.
Stage assets into a fresh target.
Record a correction as a new revision.
mustNot: Execute downloaded code or lifecycle hooks.
Invent runtime schemas for semantic-only packages.
Update an existing populated Dimension during staging.
requiresHuman: Adopting a composition into a Dimension.
Migrating an existing Dimension to a new composition.

considerations: Executing code from a model package would let any publisher act inside someone's Dimension; refusing protects the owner.
Private selection metadata can reveal what an organization is building and stays private by default.
affectedParties: People described by data in the Dimension

items: A resolution plan lists exact release references, required closure and optional edges, with receipts.
Supply-chain compromise through executed package code.
Partial closure leaving a Dimension inconsistent.
